purpose: Renew the final evaluation boundary after baseline-selection-001 by preserving its observed test partition as historical-only and reserving release-holdout-001 for one final release confirmation.

rules.development: Non-release records retain their deterministic split-002 assignment except test records, which are renamed historical_test and excluded from future development decisions.
rules.release_holdout: Every artifact family named release-holdout-01 through release-holdout-08 for each primary label is assigned release_holdout.
rules.duplicate_isolation: If a split-002 isolation component contains both release-holdout and development groups, fail without an allocation.
rules.finality: Do not use release_holdout for training, architecture selection, hyperparameter selection, calibration, policy selection, or intermediate comparison. Use it once only after the release candidate and artifacts are frozen.
